proposal.summary: An issue has been discovered in GitLab affecting multiple versions where it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.
proposal.cwe_quote: The weakness described allows for open redirection.

AV.quote: It was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the impact of the open redirection vulnerability and apply necessary patches.
